description: Operating system identifier stored as categorical text with 8 distinct values across 30 records (no missing values). Contains casing inconsistencies with multiple representations for the same operating system (e.g., 'Android'/'android', 'iOS'/'IOS', 'Linux'/'LINUX').
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Unify casing to match official operating system names: 'android' → 'Android', 'IOS' → 'iOS', 'LINUX' → 'Linux', 'macOs' → 'macOS'.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values conform to the standard set: Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, macOS.
